snippet.title: Unique Economy in Play of Battle
snippet.description:
What makes our economy system unique?
Being based on macroeconomic IS-LM-BP framework featuring:
Exchange rate mechanics
Budget & deficit control
Currency reserves & FX operations
Government bond market
Public debt system
And more!

Join our discord to find out more!
https://discord.gg/cBEsCEFcjC
